name: Thing
description: Anything the world has no better class for — a book, a sport, a genre, a model of car, a dish. It has a name, and everything else it has is said about it: descriptions, tags, links to whatever it belongs with. Reach for it whenever nothing else fits, rather than forcing a thing into a class meant for something else or writing it out as a sentence.

attributes.name: nature
attributes.description: What sort of thing this is, so the world can reason about it: place (a city, a country — places contain places, and what happened in one happened in the ones around it), agent (somebody or something that acts, holds roles, employs), event (it happens in time, so periods and before-and-after apply), object (a physical thing — it can be owned, and be part of another), abstraction (a language, a sport, a genre, a religion — no place, no time, nothing owns it, and it has kinds).
